title: chore(objectui): bump the console pin to objectui main (past 973fc20f) before the 17.7 checklist run — carries objectui#11574, #11578, #11581 and the V1 declared-node slot
body:
Filed by the QA lane (17.6 checklist run #21330), on the maintainer's go-ahead in session: the 17.7 pre-release checklist run must judge the Console that 17.7 will ship, so the pin moves first. ⛔ Not a release act — a `.objectui-sha` bump is release-adjacent work (AGENTS.md rule 15).

## Measured now

- `.objectui-sha` on `origin/main` `251a7dd4b` is `ab1879721595`, set by PR #21625 on 2026-10-03.
- objectui `main` is `973fc20f3` (2026-10-04), 20 commits ahead of the pin (`git rev-list --count ab187972..origin/main`).
- No open card or PR in this repo moves the pin (open issue titles grepped for `objectui` / console pin: 0 bump hits).

## Landings in the range worth naming

| objectui landing | commit | note |
|:--|:--|:--|
| objectui#11466 — a node slot and `SchemaRenderer`'s `schema` take the declared-node union (V1); the dashboard envelope's object-metric retires | `83e3f8377` | **declared breaking (`!`)** — its ADR-0087 disposition must be answered on the bump changeset, as the previous bumps did |
| objectui#11574 — a grouping-field switch paints only the server's groups | `2f54dca53` | fixes the phantom "(empty)" groups recorded in #21625's acceptance notes |
| objectui#11581 / #11578 / #11576 — Create View doors share one builder; a refused save is said; chart views bind an ADR-0021 dataset | `b65aa5e65`, `f1c937966`, `d0097af2e` | view authoring |
| objectui#11572 / #10380 — interface / object page relay stored view config | `09036173c`, `068564691` | |
| objectui#11588 — grid summary footer reads currency/precision from the object field only | `d768c3178` | |
| objectui#11573, #11564 — `AnyComponentSchema` / flex child typing | `bdc9049ed`, `b10c68e58` | |
| objectui release packages | `b493919c7` | |

## Scope

- Bump to objectui `main` at claim time, at or past `973fc20f3`, with `scripts/bump-objectui.sh`. Re-measure each pin citation the bump moves (`check:objectui-pin-citations --verify-anchors`), regenerate the lockstep / SDUI manifest records, as PR #21625 did.
- Answer the declared-breaking entries' ADR-0087 disposition on the bump changeset.
- Browser smoke on `examples/app-showcase` at the new pin, including the dashboards (objectui#11466 touches the dashboard producers) and the grouping switch (objectui#11574).
- ⛔ No objectui edit. ⛔ No ride-along code change beyond what the bump's own gates require.

## Done when

The pin carries `973fc20f3` (or later objectui `main`) and CI + Console Pin Gate are green; the 17.7 checklist run then builds its Console from this pin.
